}}'''Laandon''' is a soldier in the [[Band of the Red Hand]].{{ref/book|14|35}}

== Activities ==
Laandon is in [[Faile Bashere]]'s party when they are trapped in the [[Blight]]. [[Madresin Mandevwin]] orders Laandon and [[Verdin]] to use their spears to fight the beasts by drawing them forward.{{Ref/book|14|35}}

==Trivia==
*Laandon is named after Lanndon Blackmon, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
